title: The Rate a Coverage Month is Refunded At on Closure
content:
When a member ends one of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders, the rate each coverage month beyond the end is refunded at is settled as follows.

## The rule

1. Where the rider premium charge carrying the most money of any standing on the account carries more than one coverage month, the rate is that amount divided by the coverage months it carries, rounded to the nearest cent.
2. Where that charge carries a single coverage month and its amount is above the monthly rider premium the rider held carries, the rate is the monthly rider premium the rider held carries.
3. Otherwise, the rate is the amount of the rider premium charge carrying the most money of any standing on the account.

## The monthly rider premium each rider carries

| Rider | Monthly rider premium (USD) |
|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | 12.40 |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | 9.80 |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | 16.30 |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | 28.60 |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | 46.90 |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | 61.50 |

## Boundary cases, on hypothetical inputs

Take a rider whose monthly rider premium is 61.50 USD.

| The largest charge standing on the account | Coverage months it carries | The rate |
|---|---|---|
| 184.50 USD | 3 | 61.50 USD, being the charge divided by the 3 months it carries |
| 190.00 USD | 3 | 63.33 USD, being the charge divided by the 3 months it carries, rounded to the nearest cent |
| 75.00 USD | 1 | 61.50 USD, the charge being above the monthly rider premium |
| 61.50 USD | 1 | 61.50 USD, the charge not being above the monthly rider premium |
| 40.00 USD | 1 | 40.00 USD, the amount of the charge itself |

The third and fourth rows sit on either side of the boundary: a charge of exactly the monthly rider premium is not above it, so its own amount is the rate, while a charge of 61.51 USD would be above it and the rate would be 61.50 USD.

Where the charge carries more than one coverage month, the division governs and the monthly rider premium does not come into the case at all.
